questions.question: Electrons accelerated through 150 V. Find de Broglie wavelength and explain if diffraction observable

points.text: λ = h/sqrt(2meV) = 6.63x10⁻^3⁴ / sqrt(2x9.11x10⁻^3¹x1.6x10⁻¹⁹x150) ≈ 1.0x10⁻¹⁰ m = 0.1 nm. Comparable to atomic spacing -> diffraction observable (e.g. Davisson-Germer)
